armyRules.name: Nurgle’s Gift (Aura)
armyRules.text:
If your Army Faction is DEATH GUARD, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of one or more ^^**Death Guard^^** units from your army, it is Afflicted.

CONTAGION RANGE
1st Battle Round: Contagion Range = 3"
2nd Battle Round: Contagion Range = 6"
3rd Battle Round Onwards: Contagion Range = 9"

Contagion Range cannot be greater than 12" after modifiers.

**AFFLICTED**

During the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of the Plagues below. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit, and that unit has the effect of your chosen Plague.

**Skullsquirm Blight**
- Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, enemy units have the benefit of cover against that attack.
- Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

**Rattlejoint Ague**
Worsen the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.

**Scabrous Soulrot**
Worsen the Move, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1 (this rule can only worsen a model's Objective Control characteristic to a minimum of 1).

armyRules.name: Pact of Decay
armyRules.text: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select PLAGUE LEGIONS as your Army Faction.

rule.name: Worldblight
rule.text: At the end of your Command phase, if a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured. Until you lose control of that objective, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

Putrid Detonation.name: PUTRID DETONATION
Putrid Detonation.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Putrid Detonation.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
Putrid Detonation.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
Putrid Detonation.flavour: Bloated with putrefaction and swilling with infectious poisons, the demise of this hulking entity is as revolting as it is explosively hazardous.

Disgustingly Resilient.name: DISGUSTINGLY RESILIENT
Disgustingly Resilient.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Disgustingly Resilient.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Disgustingly Resilient.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Disgustingly Resilient.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Disgustingly Resilient.flavour: Those favoured by Nurgle are inured to pain, their rotting bodies shrugging off all but the most traumatic damage with ease.

Plaguesurge.name: PLAGUESURGE
Plaguesurge.target: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.
Plaguesurge.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
Plaguesurge.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
Plaguesurge.flavour: The foul miasma around the Death Guard swells and thickens, boiling outward like putrid smog.

Leechspore Eruption.name: LEECHSPORE ERUPTION
Leechspore Eruption.target: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds.
Leechspore Eruption.effect: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).
Leechspore Eruption.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).
Leechspore Eruption.flavour: Billowing from this warrior's wounds come clouds of parasitic spores that settle on the foe and drain their vitality, stealing it for the one who spawned them.

Overwhelming Generosity.name: OVERWHELMING GENEROSITY
Overwhelming Generosity.target: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army.
Overwhelming Generosity.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.
Overwhelming Generosity.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.
Overwhelming Generosity.flavour: Unholy filth gushes from Nurgle's faithful into their guns until the armaments threaten to burst like bloated corpses.

Creeping Blight.name: CREEPING BLIGHT
Creeping Blight.target: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Creeping Blight.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Creeping Blight.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Creeping Blight.flavour: Those in the grip of Nurgle's unholy plagues become weaker by the moment, barely able to lift their weapons, let alone defend themselves from the attacking Death Guard.

enhancements.name: Daemon Weapon of Nurgle
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Furnace of Plagues
enhancements.text: Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons, and the bearer's melee weapons have the Devastating Wounds abilty.

enhancements.name: Revolting Regeneration
enhancements.text: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Arch Contaminator
enhancements.text: While the bearer's unit is within range of an objective marker you control, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rule.name: Miasmic Bombardment
rule.text:
At the start of the battle round, select a number of enemy units more than 12" away from every model in your army that is on the battle field. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are Afflicted. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.

Incursion - 1 Unit
Strike Force - 2 Units
Onslaught - 3 Units

Blighted Land.name: BLIGHTED LAND
Blighted Land.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.
Blighted Land.effect: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.
Blighted Land.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.
Blighted Land.flavour: Firing diseased submunitions or belching swarms of daemonic parasites from its hull, this war engine befouls the battlefield as it advances.

Relentless Grind.name: RELENTLESS GRIND
Relentless Grind.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Relentless Grind.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Relentless Grind.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
Relentless Grind.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
Relentless Grind.flavour: When the armoured vehicles of the Death Guard advance, they plough through - or straight over- anything that stands in their way.

Drawn to Despair.name: DRAWN TO DESPAIR
Drawn to Despair.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Drawn to Despair.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Drawn to Despair.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Drawn to Despair.flavour: Those who languish in misery or cower in terror make themselves easy targets for the Death Guard.

Font of Filth.name: FONT OF FILTH
Font of Filth.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Font of Filth.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
Font of Filth.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
Font of Filth.flavour: As though afflicted with some awful vomiting sickness, this vehicle's weapons retch an endless stream of fire at the enemy, heaving themselves empty even as it storms into the enemy lines.

Eyestinger Storm.name: EYESTINGER STORM
Eyestinger Storm.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.
Eyestinger Storm.effect: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
Eyestinger Storm.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Command phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
Eyestinger Storm.flavour: Swarms of these revolting insects burrow hives into the hulls of Death Guard vehicles. Drawn to sickened prey, they boil forth in buzzing masses and descend on the foe, spreading panic and horror.

Stinking Mire.name: STINKING MIRE
Stinking Mire.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Stinking Mire.target: One friendly unengaged DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit.
Stinking Mire.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
Stinking Mire.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
Stinking Mire.flavour: Attempting to counterattack Death Guard can leave foes floundering amidst bubbling filth.

enhancements.name: Eye of Affliction
enhancements.text: Ranged weapons equipped by model's in the bearer's unit have the [Ignores Cover] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Bilemaw Blight
enhancements.text: At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, add 12" to the Range characteristics of the bearer's Plague Wind weapon.

enhancements.name: Shriekworm Familiar
enhancements.text: Once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Tendrilous Emissions
enhancements.text: While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly ^^**Death Guard Vehicle**^^ units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability, and each time one of those ^^**Vehicle**^^ units makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit visible to the bearer, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

rule.name: Manifold Maladies
rule.text: At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle's Gift. Until the end of the battle, that is your chosen Plague instead of any previously chosen Plague.

Blessings of Filth.name: BLESSINGS OF FILTH
Blessings of Filth.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Blessings of Filth.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Blessings of Filth.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Blessings of Filth.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Blessings of Filth.flavour: Employing their unique gifts, this champion enhances the weapons of their comrades with even greater levels of infectious malevolence.

Malignance Magnified.name: MALIGNANCE MAGNIFIED
Malignance Magnified.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Malignance Magnified.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Malignance Magnified.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Malignance Magnified.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Malignance Magnified.flavour: The vile talents of such plague specialists act like a filth-smeared lens, focusing and intensifying the infectious gifts of Nurgle.

Grotesque Fortitude.name: GROTESQUE FORTITUDE
Grotesque Fortitude.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Grotesque Fortitude.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Grotesque Fortitude.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
Grotesque Fortitude.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
Grotesque Fortitude.flavour: After their champion calls down the blessings of Nurgle, these warriors can fight on no matter the catastrophic, often gruesome, damage done to them by the foe.

Rabid Infusion.name: RABID INFUSION
Rabid Infusion.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that includes two CHARACTER models.
Rabid Infusion.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
Rabid Infusion.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that includes two CHARACTER models.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
Rabid Infusion.flavour: The combined talents of these Death Guard champions drive their followers into a foam-jawed fury, be it through injection with a curdled cocktail of stimms or immersion in a fug of infectious agents.

Mobile Vector.name: MOBILE VECTOR
Mobile Vector.when: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
Mobile Vector.target: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army that is not leading a unit.
Mobile Vector.effect: Select one other friendly DEATH GUARD unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
Mobile Vector.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army that is not leading a unit.

EFFECT: Select one other friendly DEATH GUARD unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
Mobile Vector.flavour: Nurgle's champions move through the Death Guard ranks like squirming parasites.

Death's Heads.name: DEATH’S HEADS
Death's Heads.target: One BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Death's Heads.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift).
Death's Heads.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift).
Death's Heads.flavour: It takes much effort and sacrifice to fashion the disgusting explosives known as death's heads, but the results are spectacularly horrible.

enhancements.name: Final Ingredient
enhancements.text: Once per battle, after the bearer's unit has fought, if one or more ^^**Character**^^ models were destroyed by those attacks, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, if an enemy unit is Afflicted, that unit has the effect of the selected Plague in addition to any other.

enhancements.name: Visions of Virulence
enhancements.text: While an enemy unit is enfeebled by the bearer's Pestilent Fallout ability, that unit is also Afflicted.

enhancements.name: Needle of Nurgle
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer uses its Tainted Narthecium ability, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer's unit (instead of 1).

enhancements.name: Cornucophagus
enhancements.text: In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy is within Contagion Range of the bearer, that enemy unit has the effect of that Plague in addition to any other.

rule.name: Reverberant Rancidity
rule.text:
While a ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit from your army is within 7" of one or more ^^**Death Guard^^** units from your army, that ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit has the Nurgle's Gift ability.

While a ^^**Death Guard^^** unit from your army is within 7" of one or more ^^**Plague Legions^^** units from your army, add 3" to that ^^**Death Guard^^** unit's Contagion Range.

Persistent Pests.name: PERSISTENT PESTS
Persistent Pests.target: One NURGLINGS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
Persistent Pests.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.
Persistent Pests.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
Persistent Pests.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One NURGLINGS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
Persistent Pests.flavour: There is no simple way to wholly cleanse a Nurgling infestation once it has taken root.

Clutching Corruption.name: CLUTCHING CORRUPTION
Clutching Corruption.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Clutching Corruption.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Clutching Corruption.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Clutching Corruption.flavour: The daemons of Nurgle grasp their victims tightly with rotting talons and coiling tentacles, their clutch as inescapable as entropy itself.

All Is Rot.name: ALL IS ROT
All Is Rot.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
All Is Rot.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
All Is Rot.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
All Is Rot.flavour: Death Guard warriors open fire into foes already embattled by Nurgle’s daemons, knowing that no matter who they hit, all will wither and rot.

Fleshy Avalanche.name: FLESHY AVALANCHE
Fleshy Avalanche.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Fleshy Avalanche.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Fleshy Avalanche.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
Fleshy Avalanche.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One PLAGUE LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
Fleshy Avalanche.flavour: The ephemeral structures of realspace have no power to halt the onset of Nurgle's Great Unclean Ones; they crumble, rot and burst apart before their unholy bulk.

Avatars of Decay.name: AVATARS OF DECAY
Avatars of Decay.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army.
Avatars of Decay.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
Avatars of Decay.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
Avatars of Decay.flavour: Countless diseases blossom in the unreal flesh of Nurgle's daemon childer, manifestations of his blessings to be spread to all.

Mireslick.name: MIRESLICK
Mireslick.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
Mireslick.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Mireslick.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.
Mireslick.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.
Mireslick.flavour: Beneath the tread of Nurgle’s daemons, even ferrocrete or plasteel soon turns to a quagmire of rotting matter, in which their unlucky enemies begin to sink and become trapped.

enhancements.name: Beckoning Blight
enhancements.text: Each time a ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit from your army is set up on the battle field using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within 12" of the bearer, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from any enemy models, instead of more than 8".

enhancements.name: Fell Harvester
enhancements.text: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Entropic Knell
enhancements.text: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of the bearer that is below its Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

enhancements.name: Tome of Bounteous Blessings
enhancements.text: Each time a ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit within 12" of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test, add 1 to that test and, if that test is passed, one model in that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds (if that unit is a ^^**Battleline^^** unit and that test is passed, up to D3 destroyed models can be returned to that unit instead).

rule.name: Numberless Horde
rule.text:
In your Command phase in each of the following battle rounds, depending on your chosen battle size, add a new ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit with a Starting Strength of 10 to your army, in Strategic Reserves.

Incursion - Battle Rounds 2,3
Strike Force - Battle Rounds 2,3,4
Onslaught - Battle Round 2,3,4,5

^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit from your army gain the ^^**Battleline**^^ keyword.

Grip of the Walking Pox.name: GRIP OF THE WALKING POX
Grip of the Walking Pox.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Grip of the Walking Pox.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Grip of the Walking Pox.effect: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.
Grip of the Walking Pox.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.
Grip of the Walking Pox.flavour: Those infected by walking pox may fall as though fatally wounded, but they soon rise again.

Smeared with Filth.name: SMEARED WITH FILTH
Smeared with Filth.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
Smeared with Filth.effect: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
Smeared with Filth.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
Smeared with Filth.flavour: Hacking a path through a horde of Poxwalkers leaves aggressors coated in infectious matter.

Gnawing Hunger.name: GNAWING HUNGER
Gnawing Hunger.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army.
Gnawing Hunger.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Gnawing Hunger.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One POXWALKERS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Gnawing Hunger.flavour: Gripped by a sudden, monstrous hunger, the Poxwalkers surge forward in a ravenous mass.

Hidden Amongst the Dead.name: HIDDEN AMONGST THE DEAD
Hidden Amongst the Dead.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
Hidden Amongst the Dead.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
Hidden Amongst the Dead.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.
Hidden Amongst the Dead.text:
WHEN: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.
Hidden Amongst the Dead.flavour: Another wave of Poxwalkers rises from the battlefield’s carrion heaps.

Shock and Horror.name: SHOCK AND HORROR
Shock and Horror.when: Your Charge phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Shock and Horror.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
Shock and Horror.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That DEATH GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
Shock and Horror.flavour: Already dismayed by this living nightmare, the enemy falters before another sudden onslaught.

Shambling Wall.name: SHAMBLING WALL
Shambling Wall.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Shambling Wall.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly POXWALKERS unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
Shambling Wall.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your DEATH GUARD unit, if your POXWALKERS unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead a number of POXWALKERS from your POXWALKERS unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack are destroyed.
Shambling Wall.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly POXWALKERS unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your DEATH GUARD unit, if your POXWALKERS unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead a number of POXWALKERS from your POXWALKERS unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack are destroyed.
Shambling Wall.flavour: Lacking even basic self-preservation instincts, Poxwalkers make excellent walking shields.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Walking Pox
enhancements.text: If the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, and is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round as the third battle round.

enhancements.name: Talisman of Burgeoning
enhancements.text: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Witherbone Pipes
enhancements.text: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, and each time that unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, add 1 to that test.

enhancements.name: Sorrowsyphon
enhancements.text: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer's Plague Wind weapon. Each time the bearer makes one or more attacks with a Plague Wind weapon, after the bearer's unit has resolved its attacks, D3 Bodyguard models from the bearer's unit are destroyed.

rule.name: Deadly Vectors
rule.text: In your opponent's Command phase, roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit, subtracting 1 from the result if that unit is Below Half-strength. If the result is 6 or less, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Blooming Pestilence.name: BLOOMING PESTILENCE
Blooming Pestilence.target: One TERMINATOR unit from your army.
Blooming Pestilence.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models in your unit.
Blooming Pestilence.text:
WHEN: Start of any phase.

TARGET: One TERMINATOR unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models in your unit.
Blooming Pestilence.flavour: Death Guard warriors know to chant the sevenfold prayers to unleash Nurgle's bounty on the foe.

Grim Reapers.name: GRIM REAPERS
Grim Reapers.target: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Grim Reapers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Grim Reapers.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Grim Reapers.flavour: Swollen with bitter arrogance, these warriors carve a path through their perceived lessers and leave them as worm food.

Undying Spite.name: UNDYING SPITE
Undying Spite.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Undying Spite.target: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Undying Spite.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Undying Spite.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Undying Spite.flavour: Driven by bitterness and the putrid vitality of Nurgle's gifts, these warriors fight on for several moments, even after death.

Signal Pox.name: SIGNAL POX
Signal Pox.target: One LORD OF VIRULENCE model from your army.
Signal Pox.effect: Select one objective marker within 30" of and visible to your model. Until the start of your next turn, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective marker, that unit is Afflicted.
Signal Pox.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One LORD OF VIRULENCE model from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker within 30" of and visible to your model. Until the start of your next turn, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective marker, that unit is Afflicted.
Signal Pox.flavour: Guided in by rasping jets of fumes sent up by this Lord of Virulence, plague-ridden artillery fire and airbursting spore-shells saturate the target zone.

Mortarion's Teachings.name: MORTARION'S TEACHINGS
Mortarion's Teachings.target: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Mortarion's Teachings.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.
Mortarion's Teachings.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.
Mortarion's Teachings.flavour: Exemplifying the Daemon Primarch's doctrines on versatile heavy infantry tactics, these warriors position themselves and let fly.

Sickening Impact.name: SICKENING IMPACT
Sickening Impact.when: Your Charge phase, just after a TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Sickening Impact.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
Sickening Impact.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
Sickening Impact.flavour: Employing their crushing bulk and contagious gifts, these Terminators slam into their victims and grind them into putrefying mulch.

enhancements.name: Face of Death
enhancements.text: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Vile Vigour
enhancements.text: While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1" to the Movement characteristics of models in that unit and you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Warprot Talisman
enhancements.text: Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battle field and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Helm of the Fly King
enhancements.text: While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".

rule.name: Hypervirulent Strains
rule.text: Friendly **DEATH GUARD CHARACTER** units have +3" to their **Contagion Range** (to a maximum of 12").

Territorial Infection.name: TERRITORIAL INFECTION
Territorial Infection.target: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
Territorial Infection.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.
Territorial Infection.text:
WHEN: Start of the Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.
Territorial Infection.flavour: The intensive contagions that flow in abundance from this champion taint everything around them, making taking ground from them a repulsive prospect for the enemy.

Aggravus Spasms.name: AGGRAVUS SPASMS
Aggravus Spasms.target: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
Aggravus Spasms.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within Contagion Range of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.
Aggravus Spasms.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting Phase.

TARGET: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within Contagion Range of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.
Aggravus Spasms.flavour: There is no hiding from contagion, and particular pathogens can incite neurological paroxysms that force their victims to give away their positions in painful throes.

Simultaneous Contamination.name: SIMULTANEOUS CONTAMINATION
Simultaneous Contamination.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit starts an action.
Simultaneous Contamination.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
Simultaneous Contamination.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit starts an action.

TARGET: That DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
Simultaneous Contamination.flavour: The worst infections spread both visibly and subtly. Thus do the Death Guard’s champions attack, ordering vile operations, the two vectors more deadly than either alone.

enhancements.name: Host of the Hybridised Pox
enhancements.text: (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one of the **Plagues** listed in **Nurgle’s Gift** (see Codex: Death Guard). Enemy units within **Contagion Range** of this unit also have the effect of that **Plague** in addition to your army’s chosen **Plague** until the end of the battle.

enhancements.name: Rejuvenating Swarm
enhancements.text: Attacks that target this unit with a **S** greater than this unit’s **T** have ‑1 to **wound rolls**.

rule.name: Warped and Rusted Animus
rule.text:
Friendly FOETID BLOAT‑DRONE/FOETID BLOAT‑DRONE WITH HEAVY BLIGHT LAUNCHER/HELBRUTE/MYPHITIC BLIGHT‑HAULER units have CONTAGION ENGINE. 
- Friendly CONTAGION ENGINE units’ ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

Fresh Vectors.name: FRESH VECTORS
Fresh Vectors.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to attack.
Fresh Vectors.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
Fresh Vectors.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
Fresh Vectors.flavour: As if drawn to flesh and matter yet to be blessed by corruption, infected weapons unerringly find their mark.

Bloodrust Deluge.name: BLOODRUST DELUGE
Bloodrust Deluge.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to shoot.
Bloodrust Deluge.effect: Select one visible enemy unit. That enemy unit is Afflicted until your unit has attacked.
Bloodrust Deluge.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit. That enemy unit is Afflicted until your unit has attacked.
Bloodrust Deluge.flavour: Warp‑tainted saturation oozes through this aggressive vehicle, leeching into its weapons, which spit the infection into foes at a distance.

Soulrot Flux.name: SOULROT FLUX
Soulrot Flux.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
Soulrot Flux.effect:
When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, roll one D6:

- On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

- On a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

- On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
Soulrot Flux.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit.

TARGET: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, roll one D6:

- On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

- On a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

- On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
Soulrot Flux.flavour: As courage crumbles in the face of mechanised abhorrence, then does the bloom of soulrot find purchase to spread its cyclic infection.

enhancements.name: - Parasitic Woe‑ReaperUPGRADE
enhancements.text: CONTAGION ENGINE unit only. When this unit has fought, one model in this unit heals D3 wounds.

enhancements.name: - Lancet of the WorldsoreUPGRADE
enhancements.text: Friendly HELBRUTE/MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER unit only. This unit has MOBILE.

rule.name: Verminous Haze
rule.text: In the **Declare Battle Formations** step, you can select up to two friendly **PLAGUE MARINES** units. Those units have **Infiltrators**.

Nauseating Paroxysms.name: NAUSEATING PAROXYSMS
Nauseating Paroxysms.target: One friendly engaged PLAGUE MARINES unit.
Nauseating Paroxysms.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
Nauseating Paroxysms.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase

TARGET: One friendly engaged PLAGUE MARINES unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
Nauseating Paroxysms.flavour: The contagion borne by the Death Guard and their attendant swarms of winged vermin triggers bouts of sickness and convulsion in those they encounter.

Droning Horror.name: DRONING HORROR
Droning Horror.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.
Droning Horror.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks:

- Can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- That target a unit within half range, can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
Droning Horror.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That PLAGUE MARINES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks:

- Can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- That target a unit within half range, can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
Droning Horror.flavour: Clouds of droning daemon flies sweep across the battlefield to envelop the enemies of the Death Guard. As their victims claw and scratch at the seething swarms, Mortarion’s sons pick off their targets at leisure.

Eye of the Swarm.name: EYE OF THE SWARM
Eye of the Swarm.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.
Eye of the Swarm.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That PLAGUE MARINES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
Eye of the Swarm.flavour: The vermin swarms intensify as the Death Guard close in upon the enemy. As their foes clutch and tear their crawling skin, pitiless Plague Marines unleash volleys of point‑blank fire into their tormented foes.

enhancements.name: - Insectile MurmurationUPGRADE
enhancements.text: PLAGUE MARINES unit only. When this unit’s attacks target a unit within Contagion Range of a friendly unit, those attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: - PlagueveilUPGRADE
enhancements.text: PLAGUE MARINES unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

rule.name: Slow Decay
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Nurgle’s Gift ability retain that ability and gain this one.

When measuring your units’ Contagion Range, Walls and closed Hatchways are ignored. In addition, Contagion Range changes over the course of the battle as shown below, instead of as specified in the Nurgle’s Gift ability.

BATTLE ROUND | CONTAGION RANGE

1 | 1"

2 | 3"

3+ | 6"

rule.name: Sevenfold Offerings
rule.text: For every seven enemy models that have been destroyed, add 2" to the Contagion Range of units from your army. Note that any increase to the Contagion Range of units from your army as a result of this rule does not take place while a unit from your army is attacking. In such an event, the increase will take effect after such a unit has finished making its attacks.

Chinks in the Armour.name: CHINKS IN THE ARMOUR
Chinks in the Armour.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Chinks in the Armour.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Chinks in the Armour.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
Chinks in the Armour.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
Chinks in the Armour.flavour: Even the slightest weakness is enough for the foulness of the Death Guard to find a way in.

Grotesque Demise.name: GROTESQUE DEMISE
Grotesque Demise.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXWALKERS units) has shot or fought.
Grotesque Demise.effect: Select one enemy unit that had one or more models destroyed as a result of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
Grotesque Demise.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXWALKERS units) has shot or fought.

TARGET: That DEATH GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit that had one or more models destroyed as a result of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
Grotesque Demise.flavour: Many of the plague weapons and revolting diseases unleashed by the Death Guard inflict endings so hideous that the mere sight of them is enough to send unharmed enemies fleeing in horror.

Infestation.name: INFESTATION
Infestation.when: Start or end of any turn, when an enemy unit attempts to Seize an objective marker you have Secured.
Infestation.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXWALKERS units) within Contagion Range of that objective marker.
Infestation.effect: Roll one D6: on a 5+, until the end of your next turn, that objective marker remains Secured by your army and you are considered to control it, regardless of how many enemy models are within range of it.
Infestation.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
Infestation.text:
WHEN: Start or end of any turn, when an enemy unit attempts to Seize an objective marker you have Secured.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXWALKERS units) within Contagion Range of that objective marker.

EFFECT: Roll one D6: on a 5+, until the end of your next turn, that objective marker remains Secured by your army and you are considered to control it, regardless of how many enemy models are within range of it.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
Infestation.flavour: The taint left by the servants of Nurgle is not easily scoured from the stuff of realspace.

Seeping Corrosion.name: SEEPING CORROSION
Seeping Corrosion.when: Your Movement phase, when a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXWALKERS units) attempts to open a Hatchway.
Seeping Corrosion.effect: Select one enemy unit within 1" of your unit and on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit, and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds. Until the end of the phase, if an enemy unit attempts to prevent that Hatchway from being opened, when rolling off, you can re-roll your result.
Seeping Corrosion.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXWALKERS units) attempts to open a Hatchway.

TARGET: That DEATH GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 1" of your unit and on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit, and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds. Until the end of the phase, if an enemy unit attempts to prevent that Hatchway from being opened, when rolling off, you can re-roll your result.
Seeping Corrosion.flavour: Crawling tendrils of foulness spread through the voidship at the touch of the Death Guard, poisoning and rotting luckless foes.

The Dead Rise.name: THE DEAD RISE
The Dead Rise.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
The Dead Rise.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Reserves.
The Dead Rise.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Deep Strike ability.
The Dead Rise.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
The Dead Rise.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Deep Strike ability.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
The Dead Rise.flavour: What appeared moments before to be a mere carrion heap suddenly lurches into foul and grinning unlife.

enhancements.text: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

enhancements.name: Fountaining Filth
enhancements.text: When the bearer is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer and roll one D6: on a 2-3, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
