rule.name: Relentless Spread
rule.text:
Each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army makes a Consolidation move:

- It can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3".

- If it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units that are visible to it (and in Unit Coherency), it can still make that Consolidation move, and when doing so can move in any direction.

Pox Flare.name: POX FLARE
Pox Flare.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Pox Flare.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
Pox Flare.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
Pox Flare.flavour: Like fever heat bursting into unclean flame, the diseases infesting these Poxwalkers flare with sudden infectious vitality.

Path of Pestilence.name: PATH OF PESTILENCE
Path of Pestilence.target: One DEATH GUARD CULTISTS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Path of Pestilence.effect: Select one closed Hatchway within 1” of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.
Path of Pestilence.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.
Path of Pestilence.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD CULTISTS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway within 1” of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.
Path of Pestilence.flavour: Long have lurking cultists planned the uprising and prepared the route for their plague-blessed masters to process to victory.

The Dead Rise.name: THE DEAD RISE
The Dead Rise.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
The Dead Rise.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Reserves.
The Dead Rise.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Deep Strike ability.
The Dead Rise.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
The Dead Rise.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Deep Strike ability.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
The Dead Rise.flavour: What appeared moments before to be a mere carrion heap suddenly lurches into foul and grinning unlife.

Shambling Onslaught.name: SHAMBLING ONSLAUGHT
Shambling Onslaught.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
Shambling Onslaught.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Shambling Onslaught.effect: After that enemy unit ends that Fall Back move, if your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, your unit can make a Normal move.
Shambling Onslaught.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: One POXWALKERS unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: After that enemy unit ends that Fall Back move, if your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, your unit can make a Normal move.
Shambling Onslaught.flavour: Relentless, untiring, the plague-rotted hordes press forward in a tide of grasping hands, stinking bodies and gnashing, splintered teeth.

enhancements.name: Pox-Bearer
enhancements.text: Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly POXWALKERS unit within 9" of and visible to the bearer; return up to D3+2 destroyed models to that unit.

enhancements.name: Hand of Nurgle
enhancements.text: In your Command phase, select one objective marker that you control and is within range of the bearer. Roll one D6: on a 2+, that objective marker is Secured by your army

rule.name: Slow Decay
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Nurgle’s Gift ability retain that ability and gain this one.

When measuring your units’ Contagion Range, Walls and closed Hatchways are ignored. In addition, Contagion Range changes over the course of the battle as shown below, instead of as specified in the Nurgle’s Gift ability.

BATTLE ROUND | CONTAGION RANGE

1 | 1"

2 | 3"

3+ | 6"

rule.name: Inescapable Corruption
rule.text:
Each time an enemy unit is selected to perform a Tactical Manoeuvre, if that unit is within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army, that enemy unit must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that Tactical Manoeuvre has no effect (that enemy unit is still eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn as normal).

In addition, in your Command phase, roll one D6 for each objective marker that is within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army and is Secured by your opponent’s army: on a 5+, that objective marker is no longer Secured by your opponent’s army.

Allies of Entropy.name: ALLIES OF ENTROPY
Allies of Entropy.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Allies of Entropy.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Allies of Entropy.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Allies of Entropy.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Allies of Entropy.flavour: The foul vitality that flows through these warriors is slow to depart, even in extremis.

Seed of Corruption.name: SEED OF CORRUPTION
Seed of Corruption.target: One DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Seed of Corruption.effect: If your unit was set up on the battlefield this turn, it can perform a Tactical Manoeuvre this phase as if it was not set up on the battlefield this turn.
Seed of Corruption.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: If your unit was set up on the battlefield this turn, it can perform a Tactical Manoeuvre this phase as if it was not set up on the battlefield this turn.
Seed of Corruption.flavour: Like infectious spores contaminating their victim, the warriors of the Death Guard teleport into battle then dig in as their foulness slowly spreads around them.

Corrosive Curse.name: CORROSIVE CURSE
Corrosive Curse.target: One DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Corrosive Curse.effect: Select one objective marker within Contagion Range of and visible to your unit. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
Corrosive Curse.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once and, until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to shoot or declare a charge.
Corrosive Curse.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker within Contagion Range of and visible to your unit. That objective marker is Secured by your army.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once and, until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to shoot or declare a charge.
Corrosive Curse.flavour: Mere proximity to these repulsive plague champions is enough to see vital systems rust and crumble as the taint of Chaos consumes them.

Cloud of Flies.name: CLOUD OF FLIES
Cloud of Flies.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Cloud of Flies.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
Cloud of Flies.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Cloud of Flies.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Cloud of Flies.flavour: Plague flies engulf these warriors in a storm of buzzing wings and pustulent bodies, soaking up incoming enemy fire and obscuring the Death Guard elite from the foe.

enhancements.name: Miasmic Odour
enhancements.text: Add 3" to the Contagion Range of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Disgusting Reinvigoration
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer destroys an enemy model with a melee attack, roll one D6: on a 5+, the bearer regains one lost wound (to a maximum of two lost wounds per phase).

putriddetonation.name: PUTRID DETONATION
putriddetonation.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
putriddetonation.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
putriddetonation.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
putriddetonation.flavour: Bloated with putrefaction and swilling with infectious poisons, the demise of this hulking entity is as revolting as it is explosively hazardous.

disgustinglyresilient.name: DISGUSTINGLY RESILIENT
disgustinglyresilient.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
disgustinglyresilient.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
disgustinglyresilient.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
disgustinglyresilient.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
disgustinglyresilient.flavour: Those favoured by Nurgle are inured to pain, their rotting bodies shrugging off all but the most traumatic damage with ease.

plaguesurge.name: PLAGUESURGE
plaguesurge.target: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.
plaguesurge.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
plaguesurge.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
plaguesurge.flavour: The foul miasma around the Death Guard swells and thickens, boiling outward like putrid smog.

leechsporeeruption.name: LEECHSPORE ERUPTION
leechsporeeruption.target: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds.
leechsporeeruption.effect: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).
leechsporeeruption.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).
leechsporeeruption.flavour: Billowing from this warrior's wounds come clouds of parasitic spores that settle on the foe and drain their vitality, stealing it for the one who spawned them.

overwhelminggenerosity.name: OVERWHELMING GENEROSITY
overwhelminggenerosity.target: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army.
overwhelminggenerosity.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.
overwhelminggenerosity.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.
overwhelminggenerosity.flavour: Unholy filth gushes from Nurgle's faithful into their guns until the armaments threaten to burst like bloated corpses.

creepingblight.name: CREEPING BLIGHT
creepingblight.target: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
creepingblight.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
creepingblight.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
creepingblight.flavour: Those in the grip of Nurgle's unholy plagues become weaker by the moment, barely able to lift their weapons, let alone defend themselves from the attacking Death Guard.

blightedland.name: BLIGHTED LAND
blightedland.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.
blightedland.effect: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.
blightedland.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.
blightedland.flavour: Firing diseased submunitions or belching swarms of daemonic parasites from its hull, this war engine befouls the battlefield as it advances.

relentlessgrind.name: RELENTLESS GRIND
relentlessgrind.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
relentlessgrind.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
relentlessgrind.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
relentlessgrind.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
relentlessgrind.flavour: When the armoured vehicles of the Death Guard advance, they plough through - or straight over- anything that stands in their way.

drawntodespair.name: DRAWN TO DESPAIR
drawntodespair.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
drawntodespair.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
drawntodespair.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
drawntodespair.flavour: Those who languish in misery or cower in terror make themselves easy targets for the Death Guard.

fontoffilth.name: FONT OF FILTH
fontoffilth.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
fontoffilth.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
fontoffilth.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
fontoffilth.flavour: As though afflicted with some awful vomiting sickness, this vehicle's weapons retch an endless stream of fire at the enemy, heaving themselves empty even as it storms into the enemy lines.

eyestingerstorm.name: EYESTINGER STORM
eyestingerstorm.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.
eyestingerstorm.effect: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
eyestingerstorm.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Command phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
eyestingerstorm.flavour: Swarms of these revolting insects burrow hives into the hulls of Death Guard vehicles. Drawn to sickened prey, they boil forth in buzzing masses and descend on the foe, spreading panic and horror.

stinkingmire.name: STINKING MIRE
stinkingmire.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stinkingmire.target: One friendly unengaged DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit.
stinkingmire.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
stinkingmire.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
stinkingmire.flavour: Attempting to counterattack Death Guard can leave foes floundering amidst bubbling filth.

blessingsoffilth.name: BLESSINGS OF FILTH
blessingsoffilth.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
blessingsoffilth.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
blessingsoffilth.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
blessingsoffilth.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
blessingsoffilth.flavour: Employing their unique gifts, this champion enhances the weapons of their comrades with even greater levels of infectious malevolence.

malignancemagnified.name: MALIGNANCE MAGNIFIED
malignancemagnified.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
malignancemagnified.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
malignancemagnified.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
malignancemagnified.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
malignancemagnified.flavour: The vile talents of such plague specialists act like a filth-smeared lens, focusing and intensifying the infectious gifts of Nurgle.

grotesquefortitude.name: GROTESQUE FORTITUDE
grotesquefortitude.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
grotesquefortitude.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
grotesquefortitude.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
grotesquefortitude.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
grotesquefortitude.flavour: After their champion calls down the blessings of Nurgle, these warriors can fight on no matter the catastrophic, often gruesome, damage done to them by the foe.

rabidinfusion.name: RABID INFUSION
rabidinfusion.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that includes two CHARACTER models.
rabidinfusion.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
rabidinfusion.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that includes two CHARACTER models.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
rabidinfusion.flavour: The combined talents of these Death Guard champions drive their followers into a foam-jawed fury, be it through injection with a curdled cocktail of stimms or immersion in a fug of infectious agents.

mobilevector.name: MOBILE VECTOR
mobilevector.when: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
mobilevector.target: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army that is not leading a unit.
mobilevector.effect: Select one other friendly DEATH GUARD unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
mobilevector.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army that is not leading a unit.

EFFECT: Select one other friendly DEATH GUARD unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
mobilevector.flavour: Nurgle's champions move through the Death Guard ranks like squirming parasites.

deathsheads.name: DEATH’S HEADS
deathsheads.target: One BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
deathsheads.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift).
deathsheads.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift).
deathsheads.flavour: It takes much effort and sacrifice to fashion the disgusting explosives known as death's heads, but the results are spectacularly horrible.

persistentpests.name: PERSISTENT PESTS
persistentpests.target: One NURGLINGS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
persistentpests.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.
persistentpests.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
persistentpests.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One NURGLINGS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
persistentpests.flavour: There is no simple way to wholly cleanse a Nurgling infestation once it has taken root.

clutchingcorruption.name: CLUTCHING CORRUPTION
clutchingcorruption.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
clutchingcorruption.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
clutchingcorruption.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
clutchingcorruption.flavour: The daemons of Nurgle grasp their victims tightly with rotting talons and coiling tentacles, their clutch as inescapable as entropy itself.

allisrot.name: ALL IS ROT
allisrot.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
allisrot.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
allisrot.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
allisrot.flavour: Death Guard warriors open fire into foes already embattled by Nurgle’s daemons, knowing that no matter who they hit, all will wither and rot.

fleshyavalanche.name: FLESHY AVALANCHE
fleshyavalanche.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
fleshyavalanche.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
fleshyavalanche.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
fleshyavalanche.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One PLAGUE LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
fleshyavalanche.flavour: The ephemeral structures of realspace have no power to halt the onset of Nurgle's Great Unclean Ones; they crumble, rot and burst apart before their unholy bulk.

avatarsofdecay.name: AVATARS OF DECAY
avatarsofdecay.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army.
avatarsofdecay.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
avatarsofdecay.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
avatarsofdecay.flavour: Countless diseases blossom in the unreal flesh of Nurgle's daemon childer, manifestations of his blessings to be spread to all.

mireslick.name: MIRESLICK
mireslick.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
mireslick.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
mireslick.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.
mireslick.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

mireslick.flavour: Beneath the tread of Nurgle’s daemons, even ferrocrete or plasteel soon turns to a quagmire of rotting matter, in which their unlucky enemies begin to sink and become trapped.

smearedwithfilth.flavour: Hacking a path through a horde of Poxwalkers leaves aggressors coated in infectious matter.

gnawinghunger.flavour: Gripped by a sudden, monstrous hunger, the Poxwalkers surge forward in a ravenous mass.

hiddenamongstthedead.flavour: Another wave of Poxwalkers rises from the battlefield’s carrion heaps.

shockandhorror.flavour: Already dismayed by this living nightmare, the enemy falters before another sudden onslaught.

bloomingpestilence.flavour: Death Guard warriors know to chant the sevenfold prayers to unleash Nurgle's bounty on the foe.

grimreapers.flavour: Swollen with bitter arrogance, these warriors carve a path through their perceived lessers and leave them as worm food.

undyingspite.name: UNDYING SPITE

undyingspite.flavour: Driven by bitterness and the putrid vitality of Nurgle's gifts, these warriors fight on for several moments, even after death.

signalpox.name: SIGNAL POX

signalpox.flavour: Guided in by rasping jets of fumes sent up by this Lord of Virulence, plague-ridden artillery fire and airbursting spore-shells saturate the target zone.

mortarionsteachings.name: MORTARION'S TEACHINGS

mortarionsteachings.flavour: Exemplifying the Daemon Primarch's doctrines on versatile heavy infantry tactics, these warriors position themselves and let fly.

freshvectors.flavour: As if drawn to flesh and matter yet to be blessed by corruption, infected weapons unerringly find their mark.

bloodrustdeluge.name: BLOODRUST DELUGE

bloodrustdeluge.flavour: Warp‑tainted saturation oozes through this aggressive vehicle, leeching into its weapons, which spit the infection into foes at a distance.

soulrotflux.flavour: As courage crumbles in the face of mechanised abhorrence, then does the bloom of soulrot find purchase to spread its cyclic infection.

nauseatingparoxysms.name: NAUSEATING PAROXYSMS

droninghorror.flavour: Clouds of droning daemon flies sweep across the battlefield to envelop the enemies of the Death Guard. As their victims claw and scratch at the seething swarms, Mortarion’s sons pick off their targets at leisure.

eyeoftheswarm.name: EYE OF THE SWARM

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
eyeoftheswarm.flavour: The vermin swarms intensify as the Death Guard close in upon the enemy. As their foes clutch and tear their crawling skin, pitiless Plague Marines unleash volleys of point‑blank fire into their tormented foes.

territorialinfection.name: TERRITORIAL INFECTION

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.
territorialinfection.flavour: The intensive contagions that flow in abundance from this champion taint everything around them, making taking ground from them a repulsive prospect for the enemy.

aggravusspasms.name: AGGRAVUS SPASMS
aggravusspasms.target: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.

aggravusspasms.flavour: There is no hiding from contagion, and particular pathogens can incite neurological paroxysms that force their victims to give away their positions in painful throes.

simultaneouscontamination.name: SIMULTANEOUS CONTAMINATION

EFFECT: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
simultaneouscontamination.flavour: The worst infections spread both visibly and subtly. Thus do the Death Guard’s champions attack, ordering vile operations, the two vectors more deadly than either alone.

chinksinthearmour.name: CHINKS IN THE ARMOUR

chinksinthearmour.flavour: Even the slightest weakness is enough for the foulness of the Death Guard to find a way in.

grotesquedemise.name: GROTESQUE DEMISE

grotesquedemise.flavour: Many of the plague weapons and revolting diseases unleashed by the Death Guard inflict endings so hideous that the mere sight of them is enough to send unharmed enemies fleeing in horror.

infestation.flavour: The taint left by the servants of Nurgle is not easily scoured from the stuff of realspace.

seepingcorrosion.flavour: Crawling tendrils of foulness spread through the voidship at the touch of the Death Guard, poisoning and rotting luckless foes.

pathofpestilence.flavour: Long have lurking cultists planned the uprising and prepared the route for their plague-blessed masters to process to victory.

thedeadrise.name: THE DEAD RISE
thedeadrise.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.

thedeadrise.flavour: What appeared moments before to be a mere carrion heap suddenly lurches into foul and grinning unlife.

shamblingonslaught.name: SHAMBLING ONSLAUGHT

shamblingonslaught.flavour: Relentless, untiring, the plague-rotted hordes press forward in a tide of grasping hands, stinking bodies and gnashing, splintered teeth.

alliesofentropy.flavour: The foul vitality that flows through these warriors is slow to depart, even in extremis.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once and, until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to shoot or declare a charge.
corrosivecurse.flavour: Mere proximity to these repulsive plague champions is enough to see vital systems rust and crumble as the taint of Chaos consumes them.

cloudofflies.name: CLOUD OF FLIES

cloudofflies.flavour: Plague flies engulf these warriors in a storm of buzzing wings and pustulent bodies, soaking up incoming enemy fire and obscuring the Death Guard elite from the foe.
